svg.title: BurstLab AWS architecture
svg.desc: A React dashboard and FastAPI controller compare direct and SQS-queued Lambda QR workers in AWS Ohio. Both workers use DynamoDB state and capacity permits, store PNG images in S3, and log to CloudWatch. SQS redrives failed deliveries to a dead-letter queue. CloudFormation provisions the stack. The controller polls job state for the visualization.
svg.text: Real QR artifacts, measured job state, and controlled capacity.
Equal application admission limits · Shared QR worker code · Sequential comparison trials
AWS service icons © Amazon Web Services. Deployment and telemetry are separate from request processing.
